enrichment.headline: Extends Burke, Williams & Sorensen's legal services agreement to June 2025 with no added money
enrichment.summary: The board is ratifying (formally confirming) an amendment to the district's agreement with the law firm Burke, Williams & Sorensen, LLP. The firm provides legal services for charter school matters and other legal work as needed. The amendment extends the term from June 30, 2024 to June 30, 2025 and leaves the not-to-exceed amount unchanged; the text does not state that amount.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Pays Partners in School Innovation up to $114,000 for community engagement on a Board initiative
enrichment.summary: The board is ratifying (formally confirming) a services agreement with Partners in School Innovation, of San Francisco. The group will work with district staff to support a Board strategic initiative, research what other California and large urban districts have done, and lead sessions with community groups so the Board's Ad Hoc Committee has evidence on possible additional measures. The agreement runs July 26 to September 30, 2024, which began before this vote, for no more than $114,000.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2024-2025 - Partners in School Innovation - General Counsel
